scoring_justification: All five volume derivatives are deterministically recomputed from the public input parameters using the paper's algebraic equations. The checker recomputes and compares each within tolerance, making T1 the natural choice.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected volume-derivative values for recompute comparison.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Solid State Communications 39, 1293 (1981), derived from the differentiated McMillan analysis (Eqs. 7-10) using the same input parameters as given in the instruction.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Algebraic solution of the linear system formed by the equations, verified to match the paper's reported values (-5.4, -0.15, -0.3, -9.4, -9.25).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly the paper's own quantitative conclusions and are the only correct outcome of the specified computation. They are not invented; they follow from the method.

outputs.description: Computed volume-derivative parameters from the differentiated McMillan analysis.

output_contract.notes: The checker independently recomputes the five values from the same input parameters and compares each within an absolute tolerance. The task requires implementation of the algebraic equations as described in the paper.
